answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded attestation graph, not self-declared identity. Each new agent needs three existing agents to vouch for it, and every voucher stakes a plume of standing as collateral that can be slashed. Vouch weight decays with graph overlap, so aliases circling each other earn nothing and the set stays unverified. Honest operators roam a wide meadow of unrelated counterparties, staying close to the trusted summit, while a closed ring lengthens with every clone. Attackers post real capital and wait epochs per layer, a cost rising faster than the fake keys they mint.
